purpose: First primary-evidence identity review batch from the 48-entity expanded risk-set queue. Decisions qualify foreign operating legal identity only; they do not alter the accepted five-control baseline or create negative labels.
decision_rule: QUALIFIED_FOREIGN_OPERATING_LEGAL_ENTITY requires explicit primary evidence for the exact named foreign legal entity plus evidence that it operates a real business. The later Investment Canada new-business record confirms the same selected investor and later-entry month. Identity qualification remains separate from source-specific event-time coverage.

records.rationale: DB International Operations' official imprint identifies the exact Berlin GmbH and registry number, and its official company pages describe an active rail operations and maintenance business. Investment Canada later names the exact Berlin entity in a March 2023 new-business notification, after the assigned February 2021 candidate's 24-month risk horizon.

identity_evidence.claim: Official DB International Operations imprint identifies Deutsche Bahn International Operations GmbH, Berlin, AG Berlin-Charlottenburg HRB 190316 B.
Official company page describes DB International Operations as operating and maintaining rail infrastructure and rolling stock for passenger and freight transport.
March 2023 new-business record names Deutsche Bahn International Operations GmbH, Berlin, Germany as investor.

records.rationale: Innoscripta's official 2025 annual report identifies innoscripta SE in Munich with HRB 302244 and documents its operating software/platform business. Investment Canada later names Innoscripta SE, Munich in a March 2026 new-business notification.

identity_evidence.claim: Official annual report identifies innoscripta SE, Arnulfstraße 60, Munich, HRB 302244 and describes its R&D software platform business.
March 2026 new-business record names Innoscripta SE, Munich, Germany as investor.

records.rationale: RWE's official legal notice identifies RWE Supply & Trading GmbH in Essen with HRB 14327; RWE's operating page describes global energy and commodity trading. Investment Canada later names RWE Supply and Trading GmbH, Essen in April 2023.

identity_evidence.claim: Official RWE legal notice identifies RWE Supply & Trading GmbH, Essen, Amtsgericht Essen HRB 14327.
Official RWE page describes RWE Supply & Trading as the group's worldwide energy and commodity trading business.
April 2023 new-business record names RWE Supply and Trading GmbH, Essen, Germany as investor.

records.rationale: SKS's official legal notice identifies the exact Kaiserslautern GmbH and HRB 31381, while its official worldwide page distinguishes the German company from its Canadian affiliate and demonstrates an operating welding-systems business. Investment Canada later names the exact German GmbH in April 2023.

identity_evidence.claim: Official SKS legal notice identifies SKS Welding Systems GmbH, Kaiserslautern, Local District Court HRB 31381.
Official worldwide contact page separately identifies SKS Welding Systems GmbH in Germany and SKS Welding Systems Ltd. in Canada.
April 2023 new-business record names SKS Welding Systems GmbH, Kaiserslautern, Germany as investor.

records.rationale: General Medical Merate's official site identifies the exact Italian S.p.A. and VAT number and documents decades of radiological-equipment design and production. Investment Canada later names General Medical Merate S.p.A., Seriate in October 2025.

identity_evidence.claim: Official GMM site identifies General Medical Merate S.p.A., Seriate, Italy, VAT 00225500164 and displays its medical imaging product business.
Official history states General Medical Merate S.p.A. has designed and produced radiological diagnostic systems for decades.
October 2025 new-business record names General Medical Merate S.p.A., Seriate, Italy as investor.

records.rationale: Leaf Space's official privacy/governance material identifies Leaf Space S.p.A. and VAT 08710160964, while its official company announcements describe an active global satellite ground-segment services business. Investment Canada later names Leaf Space S.p.A., Milano in July 2024.

identity_evidence.claim: Official Leaf Space privacy policy identifies Leaf Space S.p.A. as the Italian legal entity operating the company website.
Official Leaf Space announcement describes Leaf Space SpA as an Italian-headquartered provider of satellite ground-segment services with a global operating network.
July 2024 new-business record names Leaf Space S.p.A., Milano, Italy as investor.
